titulo: Vitachy 2 in 1 Oil Bottle Pot with Sprayer and Glass Dispenser 470 ml – Kitchen Oil Spray for Air Fryer with Non-Slip and Anti-Shock Silicone Base – Vinegar Non-Drip and Refillable
bullets: SMART 2-IN-1 DUAL DESIGN: Hesitate between spraying or pouring? Do not choose. Our innovative design allows you to instantly switch between a fine mist spray for your air fryer or a steady stream for salads, saving space and money by not needing two separate utensils.

ANTI SHOCK PROTECTION WITH SILICONE: Unlike fragile glass oil bottles, our premium silicone base absorbs impacts and prevents accidental breakage. In addition, it ensures total non-slip stability on tables and countertops.

HEALTHY AND CONTROLLED COOKING: Cut calories without sacrificing flavor. High-precision atomizer distributes oil evenly, ideal for low-fat diets, greasing pans, baking or dressing barbecues without oversoaking food.

"ZERO MESS" LEAKPROOF SYSTEM: Forget about greasy stains on the tablecloth. The ergonomically designed spout cuts the flow of liquid precisely after use, keeping the bottle clean, your hands dry and your kitchen spotless.

LARGE CAPACITY AND CERTIFIED SAFETY: With 470 ml, forget about constantly refilling. Made from lead-free glass and EU certified food grade materials, it is perfect for olive oil, vinegar, soy or cooking wine.
descripcion_html:
DISCOVER THE REVOLUTION IN YOUR KITCHEN WITH THE VITACHY 2-IN-1 OIL BOTTLE

Tired of having the countertop full of sticky bottles? The VITACHY oil maker combines elegance and functionality in one device. Designed for the modern cook, this bottle is not just a gadget, it's the ultimate solution for cooking, air frying, and dressing salads with cleanliness and precision.

SUPERIOR QUALITY: BOROSILICATE GLASS
Unlike ordinary oil tanks, our tank is made of high quality borosilicate glass. This material is lighter, more transparent and extremely resistant to temperature changes and thermal shocks, ensuring exceptional durability.

Total cleaning and hygiene (dishwasher safe)
We know that cleaning oil is difficult. That's why we designed the VITACHY to be fully detachable into 3 pieces:
1. Polypropylene head: sturdy and safe.
2. Glass Body: Wide mouth for easy refilling.
3. Silicone Base: Removable
Simply disassemble the parts and place the glass in the dishwasher for complete disinfection.

SMART SILICONE BASE
The removable silicone base (3.25" diameter) acts as a bumper, protecting the glass against bumps on the countertop and offering superior non-slip stability.

Technical specifications:
Total height: 19 cm (compact for any shelf).
Base diameter: 8.2 cm.
Capacity: 470ml
Materials: Borosilicate Glass, Food Polypropylene (PP), Silicone.
